Alafia River at Lithia to rise above flood stage late tonight.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Alafia River at Lithia .

* WHEN...From late tonight to Thursday evening.

* IMPACTS...At 15.0 feet, Additional residences downstream of County
Road 640 bridge begin flooding.

feet on 02/23/1936.

properties.areaDesc: DeSoto, FL; Hardee, FL; Highlands, FL
properties.description:
Heavy rain is winding down over the interior Florida peninsula.  The
flash flood threat has ended, however standing water persists and
areal flooding of numerous streets and low lying areas will continue
through the evening hours.  The flood waters will slowly recede
overnight.  Any additional rainfall on Tuesday may exacerbate the
flooding.

* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall.

* WHERE...Hardee County in central Florida...
DeSoto County in south central Florida...
Highlands County in south central Florida...

* WHEN...Until 1215 AM EST Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring. Numerous roads
remain closed due to flooding.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 329 PM EST, Radar indicated heavy rain due to thunderstorms,
and Emergency Management has reported flooding in the warned
area. Between 5 and 13 inches of rain has fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts up to 1 inch are possible in the
warned area.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Sebring, Avon Park, Arcadia, Wauchula, Lake Placid, Sylvan
Shores, Sebring Regional Airport, Lake Istokpoga, Venus,
Southeast Arcadia, Ona, Sweetwater, Bowling Green, Zolfo Springs,
Crewsville, Lake Josephine, Placid Lakes, Sebring Shores, Avon
Park Executive Airport and Archbold.
- https://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

evening. Additional rises are possible thereafter.

properties.description:
* WHAT...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, minor coastal flooding.
For the High Surf Advisory, large breaking waves of 5 to 7 feet
in the surf zone. For the High Rip Current Risk, dangerous rip
currents.

* WHERE...Coastal portions of Saint Lucie and Martin Counties.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Advisory and High Surf Advisory,
until 7 PM EST Monday. For the High Rip Current Risk, through
late Tuesday night.

* IMPACTS...Some flooding of low-lying lots, parks and roadways
may occur near the shoreline. Only isolated road closures are
expected. Dangerous swimming and surfing conditions and
localized beach erosion. Rip currents can sweep even the best
swimmers away from shore into deeper water.
properties.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued November 1 at 1:39AM EDT until November 2 at 7:00PM EST by NWS Melbourne FL
properties.instruction:
Onshore winds and above normal tides will combine to generate
flooding of low areas along the shore. Do not drive around
barricades or through water of unknown depth. Take the necessary
actions to protect flood-prone property.

High surf will affect the beaches in the advisory area, producing
localized beach erosion and dangerous swimming conditions.
Swimmers should remain out of the water due to large breaking
waves and dangerous surf conditions.

Rip currents are powerful channels of water flowing quickly away
from shore, which occur most often at low spots or breaks in the
sandbar and in the vicinity of structures such as jetties and
piers. Heed the advice of lifeguards, beach patrol flags and
signs.

Entering the surf is strongly discouraged. If caught in a rip
current, relax and float. Don't swim against the current. If
able, swim in a direction following the shoreline. If unable to
escape, face the shore and call or wave for help.

escape, face the shore and call or wave for help.

properties.areaDesc: Coastal Collier County; Inland Collier County; Mainland Monroe
properties.description:
An upper level low will will continue to influence storms in the
Gulf and Bahamas through Monday. With the lack of a strong synoptic
surface forcing mechanism, predictability as to where and when heavy
rain will fall remains low. However, the environment continues to
support the potential for heavy rainfall and slow moving cells.

* WHAT...Heavy rain may cause, or worsen ongoing urban and street
flooding.

* WHERE...All of South Florida

* WHEN...Through Monday evening.

* IMPACTS...Isolated to scattered areas of flash flooding will be
possible, with the main impact being street flooding, road
closures, and limited impact to structures in flood prone areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- Pockets of very heavy rainfall resulted in localized flash
flooding on Sunday and those areas, and others, have the
potential to be impacted again on Monday. Forecast amounts look
very similar to yesterday, with common amounts of 1 to 3 inches
where showers and storms occur. Scattered locations around south
Florida may see closer to 3 to 5 inches of rain. The more
isolated high end amounts have the potential to peak around 6 to
9 inches. These amounts could accumulate rather quickly, on the
order of 2 to 4 hours.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

objects such as logs, crushing anyone caught underneath.
properties.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued November 2 at 8:49PM PST until November 3 at 9:00AM PST by NWS Eureka CA
properties.instruction:
Don't be fooled by an ocean that looks calm.  There can be
30 minutes of small waves before a sneaker wave strikes.  Avoid
rocks and jetties. Avoid steep beaches.  Stay much farther back
from the water and never turn your back on the ocean.

Pointe, Hamptons At Boca Raton, Whisper Walk, Fau South Campus,

C-14 WEST, POMPANO CANAL, CORAL REEF, HILLSBORO CANAL and C-15.

properties.headline: Rip Current Statement issued November 4 at 1:09AM EST until November 5 at 2:00AM EST by NWS Melbourne FL
properties.instruction:
Rip currents are powerful channels of water flowing quickly away
from shore, which occur most often at low spots or breaks in the
sandbar and in the vicinity of structures such as jetties and
piers. Heed the advice of lifeguards, beach patrol flags and
signs.

Entering the surf is strongly discouraged. If caught in a rip
current, relax and float. Don't swim against the current. If
able, swim in a direction following the shoreline. If unable to
escape, face the shore and call or wave for help.

...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Florida...

Peace River At Arcadia at SR 70 affecting DeSoto County.

Horse Creek Near Arcadia at SR 72 affecting DeSoto County.

.Recent heavy rain across portions of west central Florida caused
several rivers across the region to continue to be in flood stage
over the next few days.

* WHAT...Moderate flooding is occurring and major flooding is
forecast.

* WHERE...Peace River at Arcadia at SR 70.

* WHEN...Until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 16.0 feet, Up to 60 homes at River Acres are flooded.
The Woman's Club and American Legion are impacted.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 7:30 AM EST Wednesday the stage was 14.5 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 10.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 7:30 AM EST Wednesday was 14.5 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 16.5 feet
tomorrow evening.
- Flood stage is 11.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 16.0
feet on 02/21/1998.

properties.instruction:

deaths occur in vehicles.

through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...Central Brevard County in east central Florida...

* WHEN...Until 930 PM EST.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring. Expect many
areas of slow moving or standing water.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 713 PM EST, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
heavy rain due to thunderstorms. Flooding is already occurring in
the warned area. Between 6 and 10 inches of rain have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts up to 1 inch are possible in the
warned area.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Melbourne, Rockledge, Satellite Beach, Indialantic, Patrick Space
Force Base, Merritt Island, Indian Harbour Beach, Suntree, Viera,
South Patrick Shores, Palm Shores, Pineda, Space Coast Stadium,
Eau Gallie, Georgiana and Melbourne Airport.
